summary.measurement_recommendation: Binarized P>=0.5 tracks continuous mean-ML tightly (r=0.9979); binarization is NOT introducing material bias at the per-locus beta level. Dead-zone (ML in [50,200]) = 12.5% of read-CpG calls; LOW -> calls are confidently meth/unmeth, binarization safe. 5hmC>5mC in 12.0% of dual-called CpGs; MAX-collapse is dominated by 5mC (corr db_max~db_5mC=0.9871); 5hmC contributes little signal, mostly low-ML noise. Per-read methylation bimodal in 43/247 testable loci (17.4%); subclone/allelic mixture structure is COMMON -> per-read modality should be reported, single-beta summary hides it.
